notes.title: TGS2025 & Development Update🍊
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Black Tangerine! 🍊 

We hope you’ve been doing well. 

Today, we’d like to share an update on KILLA’s participation in TGS2025, 

as well as the latest news on its development and release.  


⭐KILLA at TGS2025⭐ 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/05ceebd9af5633a9a6b9abeadc8350f0191ce896.jpg"]

Thanks to the support of GYAAR Studio, KILLA will be showcased at TGS2025! 

Be sure to visit our booth and grab some exclusive goodies📢 

Booth Location: 10-E17  

We’ve also prepared a special page—check it out! 

https://indie.bandainamcostudios.com/tgs2025 


📑 KILLA’s Development & Release 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/36c67fb0cd40e5835ab06652835ed6832bb38f2c.png"]

KILLA is currently still in development. 

We sincerely apologize for not being able to consistently share updates with you🥺 

Right now, we’re working on the final ending scene—and here’s a small glimpse of Harla’s scene!  

While the release is still some time away, we’ll keep sharing updates and news with you🙇‍♀️


Thank you always for your support!

notes.title: KILLA's New Demo Update is Here! 🌕
notes.notes:
📢 KILLA's New Demo Update is Here! 📢
‼ We have two important updates to share in this announcement! ‼

1. New Story Content: Valhalla and the Mentor’s Past
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/39b5bd9bdaabdb0954218fcd89f38223804b64bd.png

Thank you for waiting patiently! 😭

You can now experience Valhalla and the Mentor’s past story, which was previously omitted from past demo versions. ✨

2. Improved Translations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/20cb7ef7c9a54f6e9e363f0b862e1e358d1e7e8e.png

We have enhanced the quality of translations for English, Japanese, and Chinese (Simplified/Traditional). 🍀

We hope this allows us to better convey KILLA’s story to you.

The full release will feature even higher-quality translations! 😊

Adding KILLA to your wishlist helps us a lot! 🥺
Thank you for your continued interest!
We’ll keep working hard until the official release! 🔥
Thank you!

🚨 Report bugs using the link below 🚨
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdYeHuAAeYkhmJlK6axiglaRLD-CWRNzjf1KQc09ref76MkXw/viewform

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/6c88b62bb592fd818ad4cd60316aa32180d7ae5c.png

Hello! We are Black Tangerine.


Finally, the KILLA Demo Version is now available!


This version unfolds the story from Day 0 to Day 1.
The demo version will continue to receive updates in the future, so we kindly ask for your continued interest!


At the end of the game, there is a survey where you can leave some brief feedback.
If you participate, we will repay you with an even better KILLA.


Thank you!
Black Tangerine.

notes.title: The KILLA demo version has been released!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/99f912acc8f0a176bb3fb4d7dc6701546dca7673.png

Hello, we are Team Black Tangerine, the developers of KILLA.




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/8778f0c0b8b385195d8b555380aaf31443703bca.png

First Announcement: KILLA Participates in BIC

KILLA has been selected for the rookie section at this year's Busan Indie Connect (a.k.a. BIC). 
It was our first exhibition, and though we had many shortcomings.
BUT it was a very enjoyable experience!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/47166eeff031abc5f018475d94e101d1c536e72f.png

We are truly grateful to have been selected as finalists in the Story category.




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/5e2ee182eaa1e587286fb17cbfdce9d2d5b64552.gif

Second Announcement: KILLA Demo Version Release

The KILLA demo is set to be released on September 22nd at 21:00 KST. 


We will be uploading the exhibition build shown at BIC to Steam, 
and we plan to continue updating it. 


We kindly ask for your interest and feedback.

.
.
.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/9d35d1252b21f4776eb66966ffd5515fda053e4d.gif

Thank you for your interest in KILLA! 
We will repay your support with a more developed game. 


We will continue to update and share development updates on Steam, so please stay tuned.


With love,
Team Black Tangerine
